name: eBay Inc.
key_signal: Price is consolidating just below its 52-week high with a negative MACD histogram despite a golden cross and 19% six-month gain, signaling momentum is stalling after a strong run.
thesis: EBAY trades 18% above its 200-day SMA with a golden cross intact, and revenue growth has reaccelerated to 19.5% while operating margins sit at a healthy 23.1% and ROE at 42.9%. The forward P/E of 16.6x versus a trailing 25.9x implies the market expects earnings to catch up to revenue growth, and at 11x book the market is pricing durable high-return economics; a 1.1% dividend adds a modest income floor while the stock remains up double digits over the past quarter and half-year.
bear_case: Earnings growth of just 7.1% is running well below the 19.5% revenue growth, suggesting margin pressure or dilution is eating into the topline strength, and the negative MACD histogram alongside a sharp deceleration in 21-day momentum (2.5%) versus 63-day (10.2%) and 126-day (19.4%) shows the rally losing steam right as the stock sits within 6% of its 52-week high. With debt-to-equity at a striking 163% and a beta of 1.37, this is a leveraged, macro-sensitive name in a 'hold'-rated consensus among 27 analysts covering it — a crowded trade with little room for a mispricing to persist, so any earnings disappointment relative to the priced-in forward multiple expansion could trigger a sharp reversal back toward the 50-day support at 111.
